## Overview
This datapack expands the world with 14 ranks for you and your friends
## Commands
/trigger ranks-help to open the help center

/function ranks:ranks to open the rank menu
## Ranks
- **ᴏᴡɴᴇʀ**     | `color:#cc2222` / red
- **ᴀᴅᴍɪɴ**     | `color:#00ee00` / light green
- **ᴅᴇᴠ**       | `color:#ff8000` / orange
- **ᴅᴇᴠᴇʟᴏᴘᴇʀ** | `color:#ff8000` / orange
- **ᴍᴏᴅ**       | `color:#00bbff` / dark aqua
- **ᴍᴏᴅᴇʀᴀᴛᴏʀ** | `color:#00bbff` / dark aqua
- **ѕᴜᴘᴘᴏʀᴛᴇʀ** | `color:#ffff00` / yellow
- **ᴄʀᴇᴀᴛᴏʀ**   | `color:#25f2cc` / turquoise
- **ʏᴏᴜᴛᴜʙᴇ**   | `color:#ff0000` / light red
- **ᴛᴡɪᴛᴄʜ**    | `color:#aa00aa` / dark purple
- **ᴍᴘᴠ+**      | `color:#bb00ff` / purple
- **ᴍᴠᴘ**       | `color:#bb00ff` / purple
- **ᴠɪᴘ**       | `color:#ffaa00` / gold
- **ᴍᴇᴍʙᴇʀ**    | `color:#aaaaaa` / gray
